source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this model has shot, pick an enemy unit that at least one of those attacks hit. For the rest of the phase, models that have disembarked from this TRANSPORT earlier in the turn may re-roll Hit rolls for attacks against that enemy.
